source_text: Maledictus qui aedificaverit Hiericho — mundum in maligno positum restaurare post ruinam. Christus venit destruere opera diaboli; qui rursus aedificat concupiscentias, in maledicto laborat. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Cursed who shall-have-built Jericho — world in evil placed to-restore after ruin. Christ came to-destroy works of-devil; who again builds lusts, in curse labors. Glory to-Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Cursed be the man who rebuilds Jericho >> Bible:Joshua 6:26]] — to restore this world set in the evil one after its fall. Christ came to [[destroy the devil’s works >> Bible:1 John 3:8]]; whoever rebuilds lusts labors under the curse. Glory to Christ. Amen.
